newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian inflation slows to 0.4 pct in week.
newsitem.headline: Russian inflation slows to 0.4 pct in week.

text.p: Russian inflation is estimated to have slowed in the week ended February 10 to 0.4 percent from 0.5 percent in the previous week, the State Statistics Committee said on Wednesday.
The committee issued the following estimates:
Percentage change in week ended Feb 10 Feb 3
Basket of 37 basic goods and services +0.8 +1.3
Basket of 37 basic goods and services +0.133 +0.143
The committee does not formally collate weekly inflation data, but estimates the weekly trend on the basis of the prices of 37 basic goods and services.
